requirements.requirement: The system must ingest credential, taxonomy, and license fields from provider_detail_service.py input without transformation loss.
The system must compute a completeness score using weighting rules defined in EVAL-CRED-001.
The system must normalize the final completeness score to the defined range (0–1 or 0–100) per schema contract.
The system must produce a component-level breakdown including separate scores for credentials, taxonomy, and licenses.
The system must assign full component credit when a valid non-empty value exists for a field category.
The system must assign zero component credit when a field category is null or missing.
The system must handle multiple entries (e.g., multiple taxonomy codes) without double-counting beyond the maximum weight for that category.
The system must treat empty arrays (e.g., taxonomy []) as missing data and assign zero credit for that component.
The system must ignore malformed or non-string credential values when computing completeness and not crash.
The system must return a deterministic score for identical input payloads across repeated executions.
The system must compute a valid score when only one of the three components (credential, taxonomy, license) is present.
The system must compute a zero score when all three components are missing or null.
The system must ensure the sum of component scores equals the final normalized completeness score.
The system must handle unexpected input structures (e.g., missing keys in NPI response) without throwing unhandled exceptions.
The system must return a structured output object containing overall score and component breakdown fields as defined in EVAL-CRED-001.
